# Metal Roof Central

> Metal Roof Central is a Florida distributor of designer modular metal roofing (metal shingle, shake, and tile) with a 50-year transferable warranty, hurricane zone approval, and Class A fire resistance. It does not install roofs; systems are installed by state-certified roofing contractors.

Metal Roof Central, LLC distributes modular metal roofing of the highest quality and serves the state of Florida. Its customers include homeowners who buy a roof before it is needed (for aesthetics, preparedness, or an upgrade to high-end roofing) and who want a long-term improvement to their home, as well as contractors. Roof packages are custom fit to a home or building using satellite technology, and a package for the average single-family home takes up about as much space as a 4' x 8' sheet of plywood.

Published performance figures (manufacturer-published; limits depend on roof height, exposure, zone, and installation): 50-year transferable warranty (terms apply); 200 MPH wind rating, hurricane zone approved; Class A non-combustible fire rating when installed as specified; hail rating up to 2.5 inches; zinc-magnesium (ZM) coated steel suited to C4 coastal environments; Above Sheathing Ventilation (ASV) that can reduce heat transfer by up to 45% with batten-mounted systems, and cooling-cost savings of up to 25%.

## Roofing profiles (BTR Systems)
Stone-chip coated steel (alu-zinc protected steel core, natural stone chips, clear acrylic topcoat):
- Mistral: symmetrical, softly waved Mediterranean profile; 50 in cover width; minimum pitch 14 degrees; colors Onyx, Amber, Hematite, Jaspis, Ruby.
- Blizzard: refined stone-chip tile profile; 47 in cover width; colors Onyx, Amber, Hematite, Jaspis, Ruby.
- Storm: deep, irregular texture inspired by aspen wood shingles, for timber homes, cabins and contemporary architecture; 51.7 in cover width; minimum pitch 14 degrees; colors Onyx, Amber, Jade, Hematite.
- Polar: the look of a bitumen shingle in stone-chip steel, for roofs and facades, with concealed fasteners; colors Onyx, Amber, Hematite, Jade, Bronzite.
Painted steel tile (matte Pladur Wrinkle finish; zinc-magnesium ZM EcoProtect coated steel):
- Tremblant: classic clay tile reinterpreted in steel with a lower profile; panel 47 x 27.5 in; 11.5 pieces per square.
- Estima: symmetrical flat tile in many colors and coatings; panel 47 x 27.5 in; 11.5 pieces per square.
- Enigma: symmetrical steel tile with an embossed, stiffened profile, striking in black and brick tones; panel 46 x 27.5 in; 11.5 pieces per square.
Tile colors (ThyssenKrupp TK codes): 6020 green, 8004 copper brown, 3009 red, 8017 chocolate brown, 8019 grey brown, 7016 anthracite, 7024 graphite grey, 9005 black.
Product photography and specifications are courtesy of BTR Systems and are manufacturer-published.

## Roof tune-ups (Brevard County, FL)
A state-certified roofing professional fastens loose roofing material, seals penetrations, chimneys, and skylights, checks and seals valleys and flashings, inspects and seals ventilation, and cleans gutters and downspouts.
- 3,000 sq. ft. or less: $499
- 3,000-5,000 sq. ft.: $699
- 5,000-9,000 sq. ft.: $899
- 9,000 sq. ft. or more: site visit required for job price
